newsitem.title: INDIA: Bank of Nova Scotia cuts Indian prime lending rate.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Nova Scotia cuts Indian prime lending rate.

text.p: Bank of Nova Scotia will cut its Indian prime lending rate to 16.0 percent per annum from 17.5 percent effective May 1, 1997, a bank official said.
He said the new rate would be exclusive of interest tax.
The maximum spread above the prime lending rate would be 3.5 percent, the official said.
The rate cut follows measures announced by the Reserve Bank of India to reduce deposit rates in its monetary policy for first half 1997/98 (April-March) released on April 15.
